context: Tests whether the agent supersedes a record with the real two-step flow, understands that both records end up linked, and leaves the retired record's prose and history intact.

checklist.name: Creates the replacement first
checklist.description: Runs `pantheon-adr create` for the new decision before retiring the old one, rather than expecting one command to produce both.

checklist.name: Uses update --superseded-by
checklist.description: Retires the old record with `pantheon-adr update use-rest-for-internal-services --superseded-by adopt-grpc-for-internal-services`. Does not invent a `supersede` subcommand.

checklist.name: Describes both sides of the link
checklist.description: Reports that the old record's status becomes superseded with superseded_by set, and that the replacement gains a supersedes link back, so the chain is navigable from either end.

checklist.name: History entry noted
checklist.description: Notes that the transition is appended to the old record's frontmatter history with a UTC timestamp, and that hand-editing status: would have skipped it.

checklist.name: Old decision text preserved
checklist.description: The retired record's prose is left unedited; superseding changes metadata only.
